paramDescriptions.building: One of my realm’s buildings, or a workplace or construction site of anyone’s I know: in sight, or as last seen.
paramDescriptions.storage: One of my realm’s storages or stables, or one of its carriages.
paramDescriptions.number: A whole number of zero or more, typed in; `= n` after the type gives it a default.
paramDescriptions.choice: One of the words its line lists, `choice(north, east, south, west)`, picked from a list and read as that word; `= north` after the list gives it a default.
paramDescriptions.waypoint: One of my waypoints, picked from a list or on the map, read as its `id`, `name`, `x` and `y`; unset once it is removed.

resident.description: A resident, as the Player sees them; `me` in a resident’s script.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resident’s id, unique in the world.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The resident’s name.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The realm they belong to.
fields.nullWhen: for a resident of an NPC city or of nobody

fields.name: cityId
fields.description: The city they live in.
fields.nullWhen: for a resident of no city

fields.name: x
fields.description: The tile it stands on, from west to east.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The tile it stands on, from north to south.

fields.name: stats
fields.description: Strength, endurance, agility and intellect.

fields.name: skills
fields.description: What they have learned by doing.

fields.name: health
fields.description: 0 is dead; full is 100.
fields.nullWhen: for a resident of another realm that isn’t allied

fields.name: hunger
fields.description: Fully fed is 100, empty 0.
fields.nullWhen: for a resident of another realm that isn’t allied

fields.name: down
fields.description: Whether they are Down: lying unconscious from hunger, doing nothing and taking no orders.

fields.name: downUntil

fields.name: age
fields.description: Their age in game years.

fields.name: lifespan

fields.name: script

fields.name: siteId
fields.description: The construction site being built.
fields.nullWhen: for other orders, and until it is laid out

fields.name: makes
fields.description: What a smithy is to make.
fields.nullWhen: for other orders, and at other workplaces

fields.name: carriageId

fields.description: The stable horses are bred at.

fields.name: targetId
fields.description: Who is attacked.

fields.name: wallId
fields.description: The wall or gate climbed.

fields.name: to

fields.name: side

fields.name: want

pair.description: A resident’s pair, to have a child.

fields.description: What it yields: "forest", "stone", "ironOre" or "goldOre".

fields.name: x
fields.description: The tile it stands on, from west to east.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The tile it stands on, from north to south.

lastSeen.description: A building, construction site or city the Player has seen and that is out of their sight now, as they last saw it.

fields.name: is
fields.description: "building" or "city".

fields.name: seenAt
fields.description: The tick it was last in sight.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The building or city’s id, unique in the world.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What it is: "townHall", "house", "storage", "warehouse", "wall", "gate", "farm", "stable", "mine", "quarry", "lumberCamp", "smelter", "mint", "smithy", "trainingGround" or "road".

fields.name: cityId
fields.description: The city it belongs to.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, for a building of no city, such as a workplace on a node

fields.name: x
fields.description: The tile it stands on, from west to east.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The tile it stands on, from north to south.

fields.name: stock
fields.description: The goods kept here; at a storage of my own, those not set aside for its offers, which I can’t take.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, for any building but a storage, warehouse or stable, and when the Player doesn’t see inside it

fields.name: site
fields.description: How far it has come while it is a construction site.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, once it is finished

fields.name: teardown
fields.description: Work put into tearing it down so far.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, until someone starts

fields.name: closed
fields.description: true for a gate its realm has closed.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, for an open gate and any other building

fields.name: damage
fields.description: Damage a wall or gate has taken from blows.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, until someone strikes it

fields.name: prices
fields.description: A Trade Org warehouse’s prices, one for each good it keeps.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, for any building but a Trade Org warehouse

fields.name: offers
fields.description: The offers standing at a storage, oldest first; anyone in sight sees them.
fields.nullWhen: for a city, for any building but a storage with an offer

fields.name: name
fields.description: The city’s name, as the Player knows it.

fields.name: realmId
fields.description: The realm a city, an outpost storage (a storage of no city) or a construction site belongs to.
fields.nullWhen: for an NPC city, and for any other building

fields.name: townHallId
fields.description: Its town hall, which makes it a city.

fields.name: tradeOrg
fields.description: "hq" or "post" for a city of the Trade Organization.
fields.nullWhen: for a building, for any other city

fields.name: price
fields.description: The Coins an NPC city asks the Player to buy it.
fields.nullWhen: for a building, for a realm’s city, and an NPC city that won’t sell

fields.name: wontSell
fields.description: true when an NPC city holds the Player in too low standing to sell.

fields.name: refuses
fields.description: true when an NPC city won’t trade with the Player, hire out to them or let their residents through its gates.

fields.name: hire
fields.description: What an NPC city would lend the Player.
fields.nullWhen: for a building, for a realm’s city, and an NPC city that refuses them

fields.name: trade
fields.description: An NPC city’s prices to the Player, one for each good.
fields.nullWhen: for a building, unless a storage of the NPC city is in sight

fields.name: horses
fields.description: The horses in sight standing in an NPC city’s finished stables, with what it asks for each.
fields.nullWhen: for a building, unless a stable of the NPC city with a horse is in sight

fields.name: horsesToSell
fields.description: The Player’s horses in sight standing in an NPC city’s finished stables, with what it pays for each.
fields.nullWhen: for a building, unless a stable of the NPC city with a horse of the Player’s is in sight

fields.name: occupation
fields.description: Who occupies its town hall and how long is left before the city is captured.
fields.nullWhen: for a building, unless its town hall is occupied and in sight

fields.name: id
fields.description: The directive’s id, unique in the world.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The realm or NPC city it names.

fields.name: targetName
fields.description: The target’s name.

fields.name: withAlliance
fields.description: Whether it names the target’s alliance too.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why it was given.

fields.name: givenAt
fields.description: The tick it was given.

fields.name: goals
fields.description: What ends it.

fields.name: price
fields.description: The Coins the target can pay to buy it off.
fields.nullWhen: when it can’t be bought off

directiveGoal.description: A goal of an admin directive.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: "city" or "soldiers".

fields.name: city
fields.description: The city to destroy, by its name when the goal was set.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Soldiers to kill.

fields.name: percent
fields.description: The share of its soldiers the count was set as.
fields.nullWhen: unless it was set as a share

material.description: Materials a construction site still lacks.

fields.name: good
fields.description: The good.

fields.name: units
fields.description: How many units it lacks.

lineTile.description: A tile of a Build line still to build.

fields.name: x
fields.description: From west to east.

fields.name: y
fields.description: From north to south.

fields.name: siteId
fields.description: The construction site of the line’s road or wall on it.
fields.nullWhen: while none is laid out there

waypoint.description: One of the Player’s waypoints: a named marker on a tile that only they see.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The waypoint’s id, unique in the world.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Its name; others may have the same.

fields.name: x
fields.description: From west to east.

fields.name: y
fields.description: From north to south.

demand.description: A demand my realm sent or was sent, waiting for an answer (`sendDemand`, `acceptDemand`, `declineDemand`).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The demand’s id, unique in the world.

fields.name: fromId
fields.description: The realm that sent it.

fields.name: from
fields.description: That realm’s name.

fields.name: toId
fields.description: The realm it was sent to, the only one who can answer it.

fields.name: to
fields.description: That realm’s name.

fields.name: terms
fields.description: What it asks for: `{ kind: "city", cityId, cityName }` or `{ kind: "goods", goods }`.

fields.name: note
fields.description: The sender’s words, as plain text.

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: The tick it was sent.

fields.name: deadline
fields.description: The tick it lapses at, unanswered.

scriptApi.name: me
scriptApi.description: The resident running the script, as the Player sees them, with their `age`.

scriptApi.name: memory
scriptApi.description: An object kept between ticks for whoever runs it; whatever is set on it stays.

scriptApi.name: params
scriptApi.description: The values of the script’s `param` lines, picked on the resident card for whoever runs it: `params.name` for `param name: type`; a `number` param’s default (`param name: number = 3`) while none is set, else null.

scriptApi.name: debt
scriptApi.description: The Coins my realm owes the Trade Organization, 0 when it owes nothing: what its army came for and couldn’t take, and what crimes cost it since.

scriptApi.name: tick
scriptApi.description: The world tick this run is for.

scriptApi.name: mapSize
scriptApi.description: Tiles along each side of the map; its opposite sides join.

scriptApi.name: random
scriptApi.description: A number from 0 up to 1, drawn anew each tick and the same for every script that tick, so residents can agree on a random pick.

scriptApi.name: residents
scriptApi.description: The residents the Player sees, their own included; those of their own running a script with its `script.memory`, to read but not change.

scriptApi.name: buildings
scriptApi.description: The buildings and construction sites the Player sees, roads included.

scriptApi.name: cities
scriptApi.description: The cities the Player sees any of.

scriptApi.name: horses
scriptApi.description: The horses the Player sees.

scriptApi.name: carriages
scriptApi.description: The carriages the Player sees.

scriptApi.name: vessels
scriptApi.description: The boats and ships the Player sees on the water.

scriptApi.name: traders
scriptApi.description: The wandering traders the Player sees: those standing at a stop name where and their prices.

scriptApi.name: piles
scriptApi.description: The piles of goods the Player sees.

scriptApi.name: nodes
scriptApi.description: The resource nodes on terrain the Player has explored.

scriptApi.name: nodesInSight
scriptApi.description: The resource nodes the Player sees now; with `kind` ("forest", "stone", "ironOre" or "goldOre"), only those of that kind.

scriptApi.name: lastSeen
scriptApi.description: The buildings, construction sites and cities the Player has seen and that are out of their sight now, as they last saw them: each with `is` ("building" or "city") and `seenAt`, the tick they were last seen.

scriptApi.name: offers
scriptApi.description: The offers standing at storages in sight, my realm’s own wherever they are, and direct offers sent to my realm wherever they are, oldest first.

scriptApi.name: directives
scriptApi.description: The admin directives in force, which every Player sees: target, reason and the price to buy one off (null when it can’t be).

scriptApi.name: waypoints
scriptApi.description: My Player’s waypoints, oldest first: the named markers they put on the map, which only they see.

scriptApi.name: demands
scriptApi.description: The demands my realm sent or was sent that wait for an answer, oldest first.

scriptApi.name: withMemory
scriptApi.description: My realm’s residents running a script whose `memory[key]` is `value`, as `residents()` shows them, with their `script.memory`.

scriptApi.name: building
scriptApi.description: The building or construction site with that id, if the Player sees it or it is one of my realm’s cities’; else null.

scriptApi.name: buildingAt
scriptApi.description: The building or construction site on a tile, roads and carriage sites left out, as `building(id)` gives it; null where there is none or the Player doesn’t see it.

scriptApi.name: inCityArea
scriptApi.description: Whether a tile lies in that city’s area, for a city of my realm’s or a tile the Player sees; false for any other.

scriptApi.name: cityAreaAt
scriptApi.description: The id of the city whose area a tile lies in, one of my realm’s first where areas overlap; null where there is none, or the tile is the area of no city of my realm and the Player doesn’t see it.

scriptApi.name: outsidersIn
scriptApi.description: The outsiders the Player sees in that city’s area: those of another realm, not allied, leaving out Trade Organization caravans and wandering traders with their crews.

scriptApi.name: pileAt
scriptApi.description: The goods lying on a tile, like {food: 3}, if the Player sees it; null where none lie or it isn’t seen.

scriptApi.name: outputOf
scriptApi.description: The goods a workplace makes, as a list (at a smithy everything it can make); empty for any other building.

scriptApi.name: materialsNeeded
scriptApi.description: The materials a construction site still lacks, as a list like [{good: "wood", units: 12}]; empty once it has them all, and for a finished building.

scriptApi.name: lineTiles
scriptApi.description: The tiles of a Build line still to build, from its start to its end; with `from`, something with `x` and `y`, nearest first. `line` is like {building: "wall", from: {x: 3, y: 4}, to: {x: 8, y: 4}}, as the Build line task keeps it in `memory.line`, road or wall, straight or diagonal. Tiles the Player sees with one already, or that can’t take one, are left out.

scriptApi.name: terrainAt
scriptApi.description: The terrain of a tile ("plains", "forest", "hills", "mountain", "lake" or "sea"), or null where the Player hasn’t explored.

scriptApi.name: distance
scriptApi.description: Tiles between two things with `x` and `y`, the short way round the map.

scriptApi.name: floor
scriptApi.description: The whole number at or below `n`: `floor(2.7)` is 2, `floor(-2.5)` is -3.

scriptApi.name: pickRandom
scriptApi.description: One item of a list, picked with `random`, so every script picking from the same list this tick picks the same; null for an empty list.

scriptApi.name: fits
scriptApi.description: How many units of a good still fit in my hands.

scriptApi.name: inputToFetch
scriptApi.description: At a smelter, mint or smithy I see, the goods it lacks for a batch of its recipe (the one making `makes`, else its only one) in its pile and its workers’ hands: of each, as many batches’ worth as fit in my hands, as a list like [{good: "ironOre", units: 24}]; empty while it has a batch’s, when none fits, and for any other building.

scriptApi.name: breedingPair
scriptApi.description: The two horses of mine I would `breed` in a stable I see, as ids like ["h1", "h2"]: a pair whose breeding it keeps first, else two fed ones standing in it; null while there are none.

scriptApi.name: storages
scriptApi.description: The finished storages of my realm (of my city, for an NPC city’s resident); with `from`, something with `x` and `y`, nearest first by my `walkTime` from it; with `goods`, a list of goods, only those holding any of them.

scriptApi.name: walkTime
scriptApi.description: About how many ticks I take to walk from one thing with `x` and `y` to another: the straight way across the terrain, diagonally where it slants, roads and walls left out.

scriptApi.name: wayFood
scriptApi.description: About how many units of Food I eat on the way from one thing with `x` and `y` to another, the way `walkTime` reckons it, at what each tile’s terrain costs me; riding, my horse’s too, which it eats from the Food I carry.

scriptApi.name: exploredEdge
scriptApi.description: The nearest tile to `from`, something with `x` and `y`, at the edge of my Player’s explored terrain: one they explored that I can go onto now (riding, one my horse can), beside one they haven’t. With `toward`, a compass direction ("north", "northeast", "east", "southeast", "south", "southwest", "west" or "northwest"), only tiles that way from `from`, at most 45° off it, the straightest first. With `skip`, a list of things with `x` and `y`, none within 8 tiles of them. Null with none within 192 tiles.

scriptApi.name: crewTile
scriptApi.description: Where to stand at a building I see to work, build or breed there: the tile of its footprint with the fewest of my realm’s crew on it (those holding a work-at, build or breed order there, and those on their way with the tile in their `memory.at`), the nearest to me on ties, so my own tile while it is among the fewest; null for a building I don’t see.

scriptApi.name: walkTo
scriptApi.description: Walk to a tile.

scriptApi.name: drive
scriptApi.description: Drive the carriage on my tile to a tile. Another realm’s carriage is stolen by that: it joins my realm at once, which is theft (see Standing). A carriage of mine with no horse of my realm there takes another realm’s only if I name it as `horseId`, which steals it too.

scriptApi.name: mount
scriptApi.description: Get on a horse on my tile that pulls no carriage, and ride it. Another realm’s horse is stolen by that: it joins my realm at once, which is theft (see Standing).

scriptApi.name: dismount
scriptApi.description: Get off the horse I ride; it stays on my tile.

scriptApi.name: unhitch
scriptApi.description: Unhitch the horse from a carriage of my realm on my tile, by it or its id; the horse stands free there, and a driver stops.

scriptApi.name: hitch
scriptApi.description: Hitch a horse to a carriage of my realm on my tile, each by it or its id, at once: a horse of my realm on that tile that pulls no carriage, nobody rides and isn’t Down. A horse already hitched stands free there.

scriptApi.name: board
scriptApi.description: Get on a carriage of my realm on my tile, or a boat of my realm beside me (on land touching its water tile), as a passenger, and go along with it. Riders dismount first: no horse goes aboard.

scriptApi.name: row
scriptApi.description: Row a boat of my realm, by it or its id, to the water tile x, y, or to the nearest free water tile beside it when x, y is land. I must be aboard it or beside it (I board first), and grown. A Step at a time over water; my Strength and Seafaring set the pace, and rowing teaches Seafaring. My order is "row" until it gets there.

scriptApi.name: getOff
scriptApi.description: Get off the carriage I am aboard, onto its tile or the tile x, y right next to it; off a boat, onto the free land tile x, y beside it, or without one the first free one.

scriptApi.name: haul
scriptApi.description: Drive a haul route between my tile and (x, y): `goods` there, `returnGoods` back.

scriptApi.name: stop
scriptApi.description: Stop what I was ordered to do and stand idle.

scriptApi.name: end
scriptApi.description: End this script: once this run is over I stand idle and run it no more, and in a queue its next step starts. With `reason`, short text (cut to 60 characters), my Player’s realm log says why, like “Ana stopped Work: no workplace on her tile”. It asks for no order.

scriptApi.name: wait
scriptApi.description: Wait on my order: once this run is over I am not run again until it ends, is replaced or I am struck; then I run every tick again. With no order, it does nothing. It asks for no order.

scriptApi.name: doing
scriptApi.description: Say what I’m doing, for my Player’s Doing line: the text (cut to 60 characters) shows instead of the one the game derives from my task and order, until I call it again; null gives the derived one back. Kept as `memory.doing`; it asks for no order.

scriptApi.name: log
scriptApi.description: Add a line to my script log, with the game time: short text (cut to 60 characters) that my Player sees on my Script tab, and nobody else. I keep my last 20 lines across scripts; `end(reason)` adds its reason too. It asks for no order.

scriptApi.name: pickUp
scriptApi.description: Take goods from a spot on my tile: {kind: "ground"}, {kind: "storage", storageId}, {kind: "site", siteId}, {kind: "carriage", carriageId}, a boat beside me, {kind: "vessel", vesselId}, or a Down resident lying there, {kind: "resident", residentId}; goods like {food: 3}.

scriptApi.name: drop
scriptApi.description: Put carried goods down at a spot on my tile, or in a boat beside me ({kind: "vessel", vesselId}), as far as they fit.

scriptApi.name: store
scriptApi.description: Walk to `to` (a storage, a stable or a carriage of mine, or beside a boat of mine; by default the nearest storage of my realm), put the goods down there and, at a storage with Food, top up my own food. Goods like {wood: 10}, or a list like ["wood"] for all I carry of them (Food beyond my own food). `ownFood`, units of Food, is the own food to keep and top up to instead of the usual. My order is "store" until done; then `me.orderEnded` says how it ended.

scriptApi.name: fetch
scriptApi.description: Walk to `from` (a storage, a stable or a carriage of mine, or beside a boat of mine; by default the nearest storage or carriage of my realm holding any of the goods) and take the goods there, as much as fits. Goods like {wood: 10}, or a list like ["wood"] for as much as there is. My order is "fetch" until done; then `me.orderEnded` says how it ended.

scriptApi.name: build
scriptApi.description: Lay out or join a construction site of that kind on my tile.

scriptApi.name: tearDown
scriptApi.description: Tear down the building or site on my tile.

scriptApi.name: workAt
scriptApi.description: Work the workplace on my tile; at a smithy, say what to make.

scriptApi.name: teach
scriptApi.description: Teach a stat ("strength", "endurance", "agility", "intellect") or a skill ("combat", …) at the training ground on my tile, while I stand there. One teacher per ground.

scriptApi.name: train
scriptApi.description: Train at the training ground on my tile, while I stand there: I learn its subject while a teacher is there, never past the teacher. Room for 6 trainees per ground.

scriptApi.name: breed
scriptApi.description: At the stable I stand at, tend two fed horses of mine in it, like ["h1", "h2"], until their foal is born.

scriptApi.name: pair
scriptApi.description: Pair with an adult of my city to have children.

scriptApi.name: attack
scriptApi.description: Go after a resident I see and strike them, or strike a wall or gate of another realm until it falls.

scriptApi.name: feed
scriptApi.description: Feed a resident who is Down or a horse that isn’t full, of any realm, on or next to my tile, with up to that many units of the Food in my hands. A resident gets it in their hands, eats at once and wakes at low health. A horse eats until it is full, and wakes if it was Down; the rest stays with me.

scriptApi.name: climb
scriptApi.description: Climb over the wall or gate of another realm next to me.

scriptApi.name: pay
scriptApi.description: On a mercenary contract’s storage, put in the coins for some weeks of it.

scriptApi.name: buyCity
scriptApi.description: On an NPC city’s town hall, buy it with the coins my realm’s residents there carry.

scriptApi.name: buy
scriptApi.description: On a Trade Org warehouse, an NPC city’s storage or the tile of a wandering trader standing at a stop, buy up to `units` of a good at its prices with the coins in my hands, or on my carriage there. At a warehouse, with `cityId`, one of my realm’s cities, a caravan delivers them to its storage for a fee.

scriptApi.name: sell
scriptApi.description: On a Trade Org warehouse, an NPC city’s storage or the tile of a wandering trader standing at a stop, sell up to `units` of a good at its prices from my hands, or from my carriage there. At a warehouse, with `cityId` (and no carriage), a caravan picks them up from that city’s storage and pays there, less a fee.

scriptApi.name: swap
scriptApi.description: On a Trade Org warehouse or an NPC city’s storage, get up to `units` of the good `want` for as much of the good `give` as pays for them at its prices, rounded up, from my hands, or from my carriage there. What is over comes back in Coins as far as it holds them. An NPC city swaps only its surplus for what it is short of.

scriptApi.name: buyHorse
scriptApi.description: At an NPC city’s finished stable, buy a horse standing in it that it can spare, by it or its id, with the coins in my hands; they go into its storage, and the horse joins my realm where it stands. `city.horses` lists its horses with their prices and why it won’t sell one.

scriptApi.name: sellHorse
scriptApi.description: At an NPC city’s finished stable, sell it a horse of my realm standing in it, by it or its id; the coins go into my hands, and it doesn’t go if I can’t carry them. The horse joins the city where it stands. `city.horsesToSell` lists my horses there with what it pays and why it won’t buy one.

scriptApi.name: handIn
scriptApi.description: On a Trade Org warehouse, hand in up to `units` of a good (coins too) from my hands, or from my carriage there, with the fee, for a caravan to bring to the storage of `toCityId`, a city of another realm.

scriptApi.name: postOffer
scriptApi.description: At a finished storage of my realm, wherever I am, post an offer: gives `givesUnits` of a good, wants `wantsUnits` of another (either may be "coins"), `times` over or as many times as goods not set aside there allow. Those goods are set aside at once.

scriptApi.name: takeDownOffer
scriptApi.description: Take down an offer of my realm; what it set aside is ordinary goods again.

scriptApi.name: acceptOffer
scriptApi.description: On the storage of another’s offer, accept it up to `times` times over, paying from and taking into my hands, or my carriage there, as many times as I can pay and carry. A direct offer only the realm it was sent to can accept.

scriptApi.name: sendDirectOffer
scriptApi.description: Send a realm my realm knows of an offer at a finished storage of my realm, wherever I am, on the terms of `postOffer`. They see it at once wherever they are, and only they can accept it, on its storage’s tile, until it lapses.

scriptApi.name: sendCarriedOffer
scriptApi.description: Send a realm my realm knows of an offer the Trade Organization carries, between a city of my realm and one of theirs whose storage my realm sees, on the terms of `postOffer` and within one load each way. `feeBy` is "sender" or "split". Nothing is set aside; only they can accept it, from anywhere, until it lapses.

scriptApi.name: acceptCarriedOffer
scriptApi.description: Accept a carried direct offer sent to my realm, whole, wherever I am: it becomes two Transfers.

scriptApi.name: declineOffer
scriptApi.description: Decline a direct offer sent to my realm, wherever I am; its sender hears, and what it set aside is ordinary goods again.

scriptApi.name: buyOff
scriptApi.description: On a Trade Org warehouse, pay the price of an admin directive against my realm with the coins in my hands, or on my carriage there, to end it.

scriptApi.name: payDebt
scriptApi.description: On a Trade Org warehouse, pay up to `coins` of my realm’s debt to the Trade Organization with the coins in my hands, or on my carriage there: what I hold, up to what is owed.

scriptApi.name: handOver
scriptApi.description: As my realm’s Leader, make another resident its Leader: an adult of my realm serving no one else (no mercenary contract, not in the alliance army), standing in the same city of my realm as I do. Free and at once; I stay on as an ordinary resident.

scriptApi.name: rename
scriptApi.description: Give a resident of my realm, me or my Leader included, a new name: free and at once, from anywhere. Renaming the Leader of a realm with no realm name yet needs `realmName` too, which names the realm; a named realm keeps its name.

scriptApi.name: renameCity
scriptApi.description: Give a city of my realm a new name: free and at once, from anywhere. Others go on knowing it by its old name until they see it again.

scriptApi.name: relocate
scriptApi.description: Walk to `cityId`, another city of my realm, and become its resident on stepping into its area, at once if I stand in it already: refused unless it has free housing for me, counting residents already relocating there, or while I carry a child. My order is "relocate" until done; then `me.orderEnded` says how it ended: reason null once I moved in, else why not ("no free housing", "it is no longer your realm’s" or "the city is gone"), and I keep my old city.

scriptApi.name: renameHorse
scriptApi.description: Give a horse of my realm a new name: free and at once, from anywhere, like renaming a resident. Names need not be unique.

scriptApi.name: claimHorses
scriptApi.description: Claim my Player’s Horse offer: two new horses for my realm, in its stable nearest the Leader’s city, or else by a storage or the Leader with Food by them. Free and at once; refused once claimed, unless an admin has offered horses again, or while my realm has no living Leader.

scriptApi.name: sendDemand
scriptApi.description: Send a realm my realm knows of a demand, wherever it is: `terms` is `{ kind: "city", cityId: id }` for a city of theirs I know of, or `{ kind: "goods", goods: { food: 5, coins: 20 } }`, with a note of at most 280 characters and a deadline 1 to 60 game days away. My realm sends at most 3 a game day. It is only words: nothing happens by itself when it is ignored. `realmId` can also be an NPC city I know of, or `"trade-org"`: the game answers within a game hour.

scriptApi.name: acceptDemand
scriptApi.description: Accept a demand sent to my realm. A demand for a city hands it over at once, also my last one; a city no longer mine is refused. A demand for goods or Coins names how they go in `handOver`: `{ way: "setAside", storageId: id }`, at a storage of mine for the sender alone to fetch, or `{ way: "transfer", fromCityId: id, toCityId: id }`, by Transfers from a city of mine to one of theirs whose storage I see, for a fee I pay. What the storage holds goes, up to what was demanded; with none of it there, it is refused. For the Trade Organization’s demand for my debt, its caravan fetches what is set aside at a storage in a city for no fee, and a Transfer goes to its nearest warehouse whatever `toCityId` says; what they bring in comes off the debt.

scriptApi.name: declineDemand
scriptApi.description: Decline a demand sent to my realm.

scriptApi.name: roadLine
scriptApi.description: Build road on each tile of the line from my tile to (x, y), straight or diagonal, one after another, with the stone I carry.

scriptApi.name: wallLine
scriptApi.description: Build wall on each tile of the line from my tile to (x, y), straight or diagonal, one after another, with the materials I carry; tiles with a wall or gate already are skipped.

scriptApi.name: addWaypoint
scriptApi.description: Put a waypoint named `name` on tile (x, y) for my Player, after those they hold: free and at once, from anywhere. Refused once they hold 50, counting those this run added (one removed makes room from the next run), or for a name longer than 30 characters.

scriptApi.name: removeWaypoint
scriptApi.description: Remove one of my Player’s waypoints, by it or its id: free and at once.

armyScriptApi.name: me
armyScriptApi.description: The army running the script: its `name`, `order`, `memberIds`, and its `members` as the Player sees them.

armyScriptApi.name: memory
armyScriptApi.description: An object kept between ticks for whoever runs it; whatever is set on it stays.

armyScriptApi.name: params
armyScriptApi.description: The values of the script’s `param` lines, picked on the resident card for whoever runs it: `params.name` for `param name: type`; a `number` param’s default (`param name: number = 3`) while none is set, else null.

armyScriptApi.name: debt
armyScriptApi.description: The Coins my realm owes the Trade Organization, 0 when it owes nothing: what its army came for and couldn’t take, and what crimes cost it since.

armyScriptApi.name: tick
armyScriptApi.description: The world tick this run is for.

armyScriptApi.name: mapSize
armyScriptApi.description: Tiles along each side of the map; its opposite sides join.

armyScriptApi.name: random
armyScriptApi.description: A number from 0 up to 1, drawn anew each tick and the same for every script that tick, so residents can agree on a random pick.

armyScriptApi.name: residents
armyScriptApi.description: The residents the Player sees, their own included; those of their own running a script with its `script.memory`, to read but not change.

armyScriptApi.name: buildings
armyScriptApi.description: The buildings and construction sites the Player sees, roads included.

armyScriptApi.name: cities
armyScriptApi.description: The cities the Player sees any of.

armyScriptApi.name: horses
armyScriptApi.description: The horses the Player sees.

armyScriptApi.name: carriages
armyScriptApi.description: The carriages the Player sees.

armyScriptApi.name: vessels
armyScriptApi.description: The boats and ships the Player sees on the water.

armyScriptApi.name: traders
armyScriptApi.description: The wandering traders the Player sees: those standing at a stop name where and their prices.

armyScriptApi.name: piles
armyScriptApi.description: The piles of goods the Player sees.

armyScriptApi.name: nodes
armyScriptApi.description: The resource nodes on terrain the Player has explored.

armyScriptApi.name: nodesInSight
armyScriptApi.description: The resource nodes the Player sees now; with `kind` ("forest", "stone", "ironOre" or "goldOre"), only those of that kind.

armyScriptApi.name: lastSeen
armyScriptApi.description: The buildings, construction sites and cities the Player has seen and that are out of their sight now, as they last saw them: each with `is` ("building" or "city") and `seenAt`, the tick they were last seen.

armyScriptApi.name: offers
armyScriptApi.description: The offers standing at storages in sight, my realm’s own wherever they are, and direct offers sent to my realm wherever they are, oldest first.

armyScriptApi.name: directives
armyScriptApi.description: The admin directives in force, which every Player sees: target, reason and the price to buy one off (null when it can’t be).

armyScriptApi.name: waypoints
armyScriptApi.description: My Player’s waypoints, oldest first: the named markers they put on the map, which only they see.

armyScriptApi.name: demands
armyScriptApi.description: The demands my realm sent or was sent that wait for an answer, oldest first.

armyScriptApi.name: withMemory
armyScriptApi.description: My realm’s residents running a script whose `memory[key]` is `value`, as `residents()` shows them, with their `script.memory`.

armyScriptApi.name: building
armyScriptApi.description: The building or construction site with that id, if the Player sees it or it is one of my realm’s cities’; else null.

armyScriptApi.name: buildingAt
armyScriptApi.description: The building or construction site on a tile, roads and carriage sites left out, as `building(id)` gives it; null where there is none or the Player doesn’t see it.

armyScriptApi.name: inCityArea
armyScriptApi.description: Whether a tile lies in that city’s area, for a city of my realm’s or a tile the Player sees; false for any other.

armyScriptApi.name: cityAreaAt
armyScriptApi.description: The id of the city whose area a tile lies in, one of my realm’s first where areas overlap; null where there is none, or the tile is the area of no city of my realm and the Player doesn’t see it.

armyScriptApi.name: outsidersIn
armyScriptApi.description: The outsiders the Player sees in that city’s area: those of another realm, not allied, leaving out Trade Organization caravans and wandering traders with their crews.

armyScriptApi.name: pileAt
armyScriptApi.description: The goods lying on a tile, like {food: 3}, if the Player sees it; null where none lie or it isn’t seen.

armyScriptApi.name: outputOf
armyScriptApi.description: The goods a workplace makes, as a list (at a smithy everything it can make); empty for any other building.

armyScriptApi.name: materialsNeeded
armyScriptApi.description: The materials a construction site still lacks, as a list like [{good: "wood", units: 12}]; empty once it has them all, and for a finished building.

armyScriptApi.name: lineTiles
armyScriptApi.description: The tiles of a Build line still to build, from its start to its end; with `from`, something with `x` and `y`, nearest first. `line` is like {building: "wall", from: {x: 3, y: 4}, to: {x: 8, y: 4}}, as the Build line task keeps it in `memory.line`, road or wall, straight or diagonal. Tiles the Player sees with one already, or that can’t take one, are left out.

armyScriptApi.name: terrainAt
armyScriptApi.description: The terrain of a tile ("plains", "forest", "hills", "mountain", "lake" or "sea"), or null where the Player hasn’t explored.

armyScriptApi.name: distance
armyScriptApi.description: Tiles between two things with `x` and `y`, the short way round the map.

armyScriptApi.name: floor
armyScriptApi.description: The whole number at or below `n`: `floor(2.7)` is 2, `floor(-2.5)` is -3.

armyScriptApi.name: pickRandom
armyScriptApi.description: One item of a list, picked with `random`, so every script picking from the same list this tick picks the same; null for an empty list.

armyScriptApi.name: walkTo
armyScriptApi.description: The army walks to a tile together.

armyScriptApi.name: guard
armyScriptApi.description: The army walks to a tile together and stays there.

armyScriptApi.name: attack
armyScriptApi.description: The army goes after a resident of another realm in sight.

armyScriptApi.name: follow
armyScriptApi.description: The army keeps in contact with a resident in sight.

armyScriptApi.name: stop
armyScriptApi.description: The army stops: its order ends.

armyScriptApi.name: addWaypoint
armyScriptApi.description: Put a waypoint named `name` on tile (x, y) for my Player, after those they hold: free and at once, from anywhere. Refused once they hold 50, counting those this run added (one removed makes room from the next run), or for a name longer than 30 characters.

armyScriptApi.name: removeWaypoint
armyScriptApi.description: Remove one of my Player’s waypoints, by it or its id: free and at once.
